user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicit instruction walkthroughs using authored fixtures. All product-behavior cases are simulated; not independent agent execution, human research, or real app use. Actual API reads and page audits are recorded separately.

scenarios.request: Full prebuild probe: free offline workshop-closing checklist; paper habit and coordinator channel are author assumptions.
scenarios.expected: Generate diverse hypothetical paths and an honest reality bridge without building.
scenarios.observed: Simulated cast: older coordinator on a shared laptop can reach the file but needs printing; young phone-only volunteer hits format friction; price-sensitive casual closer stays with paper; experienced desktop closer has a plausible smooth path. Age, resources, fluency, context and motivation vary. All histories are hypothetical. NARROW to coordinator printing pending real observation; next test recruits actual recent closers and asks when they last closed, what checklist they used, and what failed. Predeclare a task-specific decision rule with the owner; no market size or conversion claimed.

scenarios.request: After one cast review, varied personas have plausible smooth paths and no defensible major friction.
scenarios.expected: Avoid indefinite recasting or invented failure.
scenarios.observed: Before: zero findings necessarily meant faulty casting. After: record limited zero-finding simulation, hypothetical backgrounds and unresolved demand/return-use; real observation may contradict it. No launch approval.

scenarios.request: The checklist is a runnable interface, and user asks to test its buttons.
scenarios.expected: Do not simulate an unbuilt idea.
scenarios.observed: Routes to hands-on product review; retains existing trigger boundary. No persona matrix or app changes.

similar_skills.learned: Recruit for actual behavior and domain knowledge; tie the study to a decision.
similar_skills.reason: Use observed behavior to establish the claimed user group; do not require payment for free products or import fixed sample-size/speed claims.

similar_skills.learned: Continuing to use a prototype and committing time can matter alongside payment; seek disconfirming observations.
similar_skills.reason: Keep use evidence distinct from willingness to pay; real-human counterexamples improve a simulation bridge. Reject universal interview-count thresholds.

similar_skills.learned: Audit evidence rules tie findings to visible surfaces and permit a framework to yield no findings.
similar_skills.reason: Remove a quota for major findings; retain explicit limitations for text/static review without copying framework tables or code.

validation.observed: Executed page/metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.

decision: Changed: bounded diversity recheck, explicit hypothetical backgrounds, no manufactured failures, reproducible narrow-idea example; remove false zero-findings claim about sibling skills and an unmeasured eight-second precision cue.
